reviews.text: Went to Kendall Animal Hospital for first time and staff was very helpful and sweet. Joe  was very knowledgeable and helpful with our first puppy. Thank you
Excellent service! Very professional. Highly recommended. Thank you.

The best place for professional service. Thanks to Angela, the staff, and the doctors. We've been going to this place for 11 years. We now live in Central Florida and travel 4 hours to visit this hospital. Good bless. The best place for treatment. Thanks to Angela, the staff, and the doctors. We've been going to them for 11 years. Now we travel 4 hours from Davenport, Central Florida, to see our 15-year-old Yorkie. Thank you, thank you!
Great experience with the staff and doctor! They were very understanding, listened to my concerns regarding my puppy's treatment plan, and helped me stick to what was necessary.
Jose, thank you so much for the five-star rating. We appreciate your support and are happy to hear you were satisfied. We hope to serve you again soon.

The care we received at this clinic was wonderful. All the staff were very attentive and kind. I especially want to highlight Óscar, the technician, because he was truly incredible. You could see the care and patience with which he treated my pet. He was so kind, careful, and attentive to every detail, and as a pet owner, that's something you really appreciate, especially when you arrive worried. It's very reassuring to find people who not only do their job but also do it with so much love and dedication. I also want to mention the doctor, who was very professional and attentive. Thank you to the whole team for the excellent care. Without a doubt, this is a clinic I recommend and would return to.

Excellent experience at this veterinary clinic! I was there on Saturday, and it was busy, but everything was great. The whole team was wonderful and very professional. ❤️ I especially want to highlight the two young women at the front desk, who were incredibly kind, attentive, and caring at all times. I also want to mention Óscar, the technician, who is an excellent person, very attentive and dedicated.

Overall, the entire team was wonderful, and the doctor was excellent, very professional, and took the time to attend to and explain everything. You can tell they truly love what they do and have a great commitment to the animals. 🐾❤️ Thank you so much to the whole team for the excellent care! I definitely recommend this clinic ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐.

Bunch of incredibly kind professionals here — brought my recently adopted street cat for his first general health check here and they voided the consultation cost because he was a stray; they also correctly prescribed him a corticosteroid for his skin condition on the first try. All the folk that work here are very evidently passionate about animal care and are very sweet when handling pets. Their pricing is also very reasonable and their annual feline/canine memberships really do make financial sense if you’re going to be taking your pet in regularly for care as one should.
